delegated_owner_decision.decision: Packet 3 validates the six signed ADR-0125 artifacts already accepted by HistoricalStudyVerifier.bind; it does not implement a second lifecycle, planner, capture writer, or CapturedAuthorizationSet.
delegated_owner_decision.rationale: This closes the retained unsigned-placeholder family without pre-empting Packets 4-8. Canonical bytes preserve duplicate-key and encoding evidence; the existing ReleaseKeyring and TrustedClock remain the signature and time seams; one abstract revocation view is the missing trusted input.

object_set.closure: Each top-level object, key object, subject_ref, authority_ref, execution_authority_ref, and application array/object named by these six schemas is exact/default-deny as stated by ADR-0125. Packet 3 accepts no alternate, v1 fallback, nullable default, placeholder, or consumed boolean field.

trusted_inputs.signature: Injected dskit.pipeline.trust.ReleaseKeyring verifies the exact canonical preimage with the named self-digest and signature omitted. The envelope algorithm must be Ed25519; dskit does not hold signing keys or mint signatures.
trusted_inputs.clock: Injected dskit.pipeline.trust.TrustedClock is the only source of now_ms; caller time is never accepted.
trusted_inputs.revocation: A new abstract HistoricalStudyRevocations verifies the exact revocation snapshot and key id/version at trusted now_ms. False or raised verification refuses.
trusted_inputs.lifecycle: The existing frozen LifecycleAuthority remains the only CAPTURED writer. Packet 3 neither edits trust.py nor claims durable admission consumption; F5A-R23 remains open.

contract.input: bind accepts exact built-in bytes containing canonical UTF-8/sorted-key/compact/ASCII/finite JSON for the named artifact. Dicts, strings, bytearray, subclasses, decoded or noncanonical JSON refuse.
contract.digest: Each named self-digest equals SHA-256 of the complete object with only that digest and signature omitted; the signature covers those same canonical bytes.
contract.envelope: Exact issuer_role/key_usage/schema pairs, Ed25519, exact {key_id,key_version}, integer instants, not_before_ms <= issued_at_ms <= expires_at_ms, current trusted time within the inclusive validity window, and trusted unrevoked snapshot/key are required.
contract.chronology: scope_intent <= CES <= PEA <= BVP <= CAS <= admission by issued_at_ms. Shared study, subject, purpose, document/contract/component/PIS and predecessor digests are byte-equal where the ADR-0125 objects expose them; the admission union must match its action or replay subject and every named predecessor digest.
contract.atomicity: A refused bind stores none of that call. capture and driver.capture revalidate all six raw artifacts, current time, revocation and chain equality immediately before delegating; any refusal leaves the publication at PUBLISHED and creates no session.
contract.positive: A fully canonical, signed, current, unrevoked, chronology-consistent synthetic action or replay chain reaches the unchanged F4 capture doorway and remains deployment_eligible=false.
